pages.title: Recover
pages.text:
**Stone.** Unravel Thread to string, spin yarn, tie a Knot, raise a Loomframe. The Tension Barrel makes clay; clay makes porcelain; porcelain carries lava.

Then the sieve. It is a tool inside Recover, not the name of it. Iron mesh is the target: that is where Strand Filament starts falling.
